about: The evangelium of the formulary “Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed — Mass II” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus said to the crowds of the Jews: Everything that the Father gives me will come to me; and the one who comes to me I will not cast out, because I came down from heaven not to do my will, but the will of Him who sent me. And this is the will of Him who sent me, the Father: that of all that He has given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up on the last day. And this is the will of my Father who sent me: that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him may have eternal life, and I myself will raise him up on the last day.
